art_direction: 银白短发女性在池边石桥回身微笑，浅珊瑚夏装与青绿水影交织。
composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 29-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Give her cool gray eyes, gently sculpted adult cheekbones, a delicate nose, and an easy smile. Silver-white feathered hair is tucked behind one ear. Her outfit is an opaque coral short-sleeved cotton top, ivory wide-leg cropped trousers, and flat tan sandals. She pauses on a small stone garden bridge and turns her head toward the viewer, with one hand resting lightly on the strap of a compact shoulder bag while the other hangs naturally beside her leg. The turn remains comfortable and modest, with no exaggerated twisting. A quiet pond, dark green reeds, and a single low maple branch frame the scene. Use coral, silver, warm ivory, and deep celadon, with gentle side light and soft water reflections. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory heroine-v2-ninety/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized.
